LeaseLens · MGT 409

LeaseLens

Know the block and the landlord before you sign.

Adedeji "Deji" Adebayo · Yale SOM, MGT 409 · October 2026

Repository: https://github.com/Uncle-zoom/leaselens

The problem

What is this block like at night, and who will I deal with when something breaks?

The answers are in public records, but listing sites do not show them and the owner is often an LLC with a name that tells a renter nothing.

What is new

  • Walking minutes and noise sources for any US address
  • Street-level reports from the public record
  • Owner → registry → principal → other companies and buildings, each link labelled with how it was matched and a confidence level

JustFix Who Owns What is NYC only; Walk Score and HowLoud do not trace owners.

How it works

The app

Walking minutes and map for 360 State Street
AI verdict, questions to ask and an email draft (never sent)

The ownership reveal

88parcels linked to one New Haven owner (10 by exact name, 78 by shared mailing address)
239registered companies list OCEAN MANAGEMENT, LLC as a principal (owner of 311 Blake St)

Each link shows its match type and confidence. Public records, not conclusions.

The ownership trail in the app

Cost

$0.0017one address, all agents (3.0 model calls)
$0.0063comparing 3 addresses (10.0 calls)
$0.0181per user per month (my assumption: 5 addresses)
  • Caching cut the cost of the test workload by 21%
  • 15.7 s from address to AI verdict, was about 40 s
  • Measured from 140 real model calls, $0.0810 in total

Safety

Instruction hidden in a street report is removed
Invented number and name removed by the fact check

Also: spending caps, a wording rule, no residence addresses stored, 50 contrast checks passed.
